scope: Original static DLL/PDB workflow; actual file parser is native/tools/hades_assets.py. Does not prove GPU upload/audio/video availability.

equip.manifest: Synchronously calls LoadManifest(name,false) before queueing; definition GameData lookup is independent of graphics package completion.
equip.request: Copies name, bool, callback into PackageItem; enqueue protected worker queue, WakeAllConditionVariable.
equip.timing: Equip continues before package worker reads package; no wait and no Lua success result.

standalone_LoadPackages.name_mapping: Each input name looked up in GameDataManager::GetUnitPackageName. Nonnull/nonempty mapped value replaces original name. That is exact-case string hash map lookup; unmapped names stay unchanged. This rewrite does not appear in EquipWeapon.

worker.order: Pop queued PackageItem; call LoadPackage(name,bool), then if callback nonnull enqueue completion Item. No return-status test between load and completion.
worker.completion: GameAssetManager::Update RVA1ed150 drains completed items and calls callback(name) outside completion lock.
worker.meaning: A callback proves worker LoadPackage returned. It is not an independently checked success or GPU fence.

files.manifest: LoadManifestList builds name + .pkg_manifest, reads resource directory, loads include/atlas/BinkAtlas metadata. Actual SGGv7 parser is shared with Package reader.
files.package: LoadPackage builds name + .pkg then ReadPackageFile processes asset records and multi-texture atlas maps. Includes traverse package dependencies.
files.data_boundary: No unit/weapon SJSON loading call occurs in bounded EquipWeapon/async package chain; Weapon::Create separately gets already registered GameData.

failure_policy.observed: LoadManifestList errors reading file, unexpected package version and compressed manifests call Log::Write(level0x10) then cleanup/continue. ReadPackageFile missing/open failure logs Package load failed %s and returns. Async wrapper does not expose a failure return to Lua. Worker completion has no success check.
failure_policy.implementation_guidance: Retain original asynchronous timing and explicit inspectable failure state. A local fail-closed error for unsupported decoding is reconstruction policy, not original Lua exception behavior. Never mark assets complete merely for inserting a package name.

parser_reuse.api: Package(path).entries() yields bounded SGGv7 entries; atlas manifest and texture package can be joined by actual texture identity.
parser_reuse.related: hades/native/tools/build_graphics_scene.py lines84 onward shows current Tartarus/Fx joining.
parser_reuse.limit: Parser availability does not establish native admission/runtime completion API.

unknowns: Boolean parameter semantic name/group-unload policy requires PDB member/type expansion.
No GPU fence/texture-ready guarantee proven after worker LoadPackage return.
Exact missing-manifest entries/cache state and retry policy need full decompiler follow-up; only logging and no Lua return are currently established.
